opening.argument: The presentation leads with extraordinary cryptocurrency and dollar-return claims: 747 Ethereum in 35 days, more than $10,000 a month, income while sleeping, and targets reaching 5,120 ETH. It then directs viewers into a paid, tiered structure: purchase and repeatedly activate slots, authorize transactions through MetaMask or Trust Wallet, and pursue all 24 slots. The mechanics expressly depend on allocation through the matrix and reinvestment, while earnings are linked to spillover from an active team, team building, and lead generation. Viewers are also told to contact the person who invited them and are provided copy-and-paste scripts to build the business. Although it says individual results vary, that qualification does not change the central appeal of unusually large returns tied to paid participation and recruitment.
